explanation: Let dp[v] be the fewest coins for amount v. For each amount, try every coin as its last coin; retain an unreachable sentinel when no previous amount can form it.
timeComplexity: O(amount times c) time for c coin values. For each amount from 1 to amount, every one of c coins is tried as the final coin.
spaceComplexity: O(amount) auxiliary space. The table has amount+1 integer entries.
attribution: Original repository-authored Blind75 C++ algorithm, promoted from the validated correct fixtures. Collection membership follows Crackr; no external solution service is used.
correctness: For every amount v, the last coin of any solution leaves a smaller amount v-coin. Once those smaller optima are known, choosing one plus their minimum gives the optimum for v. If every predecessor is unreachable, v is unreachable too. Starting dp[0]=0 establishes the base case.
walkthrough: For coins [3,5] and amount 11, one valid construction is 3+3+5, using three coins. Neither one coin nor any two-coin sum from {3,5} equals 11. Return the minimum count 3.
edgeCases: Coin values are positive and distinct, and may be reused.
